newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian jet makes emergency landing in Siberia.
newsitem.headline: Russian jet makes emergency landing in Siberia.

text.p: A Russian Tupolev Tu-154 jet carrying 151 passengers made an emergency landing in Chita, in Eastern Siberia, on Monday due to technical problems with one of its three engines, an aviation official said.
A Russian Air Traffic Centre official told Reuters that the aircraft, which belonged to ChitaAvia, the Siberia-based carrier, was on a scheduled flight from Chita to Moscow.
"It made the emergency landing at 9 a.m. Moscow time (0500 GMT) at Chita airport. Nobody was hurt," the official said.
He said that 20 minutes after the jet took off the "dust in oil" alarm signal flashed in the cockpit.
"The crew switched off the defective engine immediately and made the landing after almost all the fuel had been released while the plane was in the air," he said.
